000805: function characterLocalImageExistsV6(imageUrl) {
000806:     const value = String(imageUrl || '');
000807:     if (!/^\/assets\/images\//i.test(value)) return true;
000808:     try {
000809:         const fsV6 = require('fs');
000810:         const pathV6 = require('path');
000811:         const full = pathV6.join(__dirname, value.replace(/^\/+/, ''));
000812:         const st = fsV6.statSync(full);
000813:         return st.isFile() && st.size > 256;
000814:     } catch (_) {
000815:         return false;
000816:     }

003432: function rgAliasV3(universeKey, n) {
003433:     const t = (typeof RG_ALIASES_V3 !== 'undefined') ? RG_ALIASES_V3[universeKey]?.[n] : null;
003434:     return t ? normalizeRG(t) : n;

003437: function rgApplyKnownAliases(universeKey, value) {
003438:     let n = normalizeRG(value);
003439:     if (!n) return n;
003440: 
003441:     // V3 : noms VF / anglais / japonais / anciennes écritures (prioritaire).
003442:     const v3 = rgAliasV3(universeKey, n);
003443:     if (v3 !== n) return v3;
003444: 
003445:     // Alias propres à l'univers (formes, surnoms, anciennes écritures).
003446:     if (typeof RG_EXTRA_ALIASES !== 'undefined' && RG_EXTRA_ALIASES[universeKey]?.[n]) {
003447:         n = normalizeRG(RG_EXTRA_ALIASES[universeKey][n]);
003448:     }
003449: 
003450:     // Alias historiques du Rolland Garos.
003451:     if (typeof ALIAS_RG !== 'undefined' && ALIAS_RG[n]) {
003452:         n = normalizeRG(ALIAS_RG[n]);
003453:     }
003454: 
003455:     // Alias issus du nettoyage DLE (Mikey -> Manjiro, Goku -> Son Goku, etc.).
003456:     if (typeof DLE_MASTER_ALIASES !== 'undefined' && DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[universeKey]?.[n]) {
003457:         n = normalizeRG(DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[universeKey][n]);
003458:     }
003459: 
003460:     // Les anciens alias peuvent pointer vers un nom renommé en VF : on suit la chaîne.
003461:     return rgAliasV3(universeKey, n);
003462: }

003464: function rgCanonicalInput(universeKey, value, pool) {
003465:     const norms = new Set(pool.map(name => normalizeRG(name)));
003466: 
003467:     // 0) Nom exact du pool : prioritaire (évite qu'un alias d'un autre univers le détourne,
003468:     //    ex. "Arthur" dans Fire Force ou "Dragon" qui pointaient vers One Piece / SDS).

003470:     if (norms.has(brut)) return brut;

003472:     // 1) Forme brute + alias connus.
003473:     let n = rgApplyKnownAliases(universeKey, value);
003474:     if (norms.has(n)) return n;

003476:     // 2) Retire les descripteurs de formes puis retente les alias.
003477:     const stripped = rgStripFormDescriptors(value);

003479:         n = rgApplyKnownAliases(universeKey, stripped);
003480:         if (norms.has(n)) return n;

008741: function dleMasterCanonicalNorm(universeKey, rawName) {
008742:     const n = normalizeDle(rawName);

008744:     const aliased = DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[universeKey]?.[n] || n;

008746:         ...(DLE_TARGET_NAMES[universeKey] || []),
008747:         ...(DLE_MASTER_NAMES[universeKey] || [])
008748:     ];
008749:     return names.some(x => {
008750:         const xn = normalizeDle(x);
008751:         return (DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[universeKey]?.[xn] || xn) === aliased;
008752:     }) ? aliased : null;

008778: function isRealDleValue(v) {
008779:     if (v === undefined || v === null) return false;
008780:     const s = String(v).trim();
008781:     if (!s || s === '?') return false;
008782:     return !/^(non révélé|non precise|non précisé|non précisée|non précisés|non précisées|non révélé \/ non précisé|donnée invalide)$/i
008783:         .test(normalizeDle(s));
008784: }

008790: async function loadVerifiedDleProfilesFromDb() {
008791:     if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) return;

008793:         const result = await pool.query('SELECT universe_key, norm_name, display_name, attrs FROM dle_profiles');
008794:         let duplicatesIgnored = 0, outsideMasterIgnored = 0;
008795:         for (const row of result.rows) {
008796:             const base = DLE_UNIVERSES[row.universe_key];
008797:             if (!base || !DLE_VERIFIED_PROFILES[row.universe_key]) continue;
008798:             if (!isCompleteDleAttrs(row.attrs, base.categories)) continue;
008799:             const canonical = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(row.universe_key, row.display_name || row.norm_name);
008800:             if (!canonical) { outsideMasterIgnored++; continue; }
008801:             const map = DLE_VERIFIED_PROFILES[row.universe_key];
008802:             if (map.has(canonical)) { duplicatesIgnored++; continue; }
008803:             map.set(canonical, {
008804:                 name: dleMasterDisplayName(row.universe_key, canonical),
008805:                 attrs: row.attrs,
008806:                 attrKnown: Object.fromEntries(base.categories.map(cat => [cat.key, true])),
008807:                 profiled: true
008808:             });
008809:         }
008810:         console.log(`[AnimeDLE] Profils DB: doublons ignorés=${duplicatesIgnored}, hors liste maître=${outsideMasterIgnored}.`);
008811:     } catch (e) {

009213: function dleExpandedUniverse(key) {
009214:     const base = dleBaseUniverse(key);
009215:     const byCanonical = new Map();
009216: 
009217:     // Les fiches statiques détaillées priment sur les fiches de base (plus anciennes et simplifiées :
009218:     // ex. Naruto « Vent » seul au lieu de toutes ses natures de chakra).
009219:     const staticCanon = new Set(Object.entries(DLE_STATIC_PROFILES[key] || {})
009220:         .filter(([, attrs]) => isCompleteDleAttrs(attrs, base.categories))
009221:         .map(([n]) => dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, n)).filter(Boolean));
009222: 
009223:     for (const c of (base.characters || [])) {
009224:         const canonical = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, c.name);
009225:         if (!canonical || byCanonical.has(canonical) || staticCanon.has(canonical)) continue;
009226:         byCanonical.set(canonical, {
009227:             name: dleMasterDisplayName(key, canonical), attrs: { ...(c.attrs || {}) },
009228:             attrKnown: Object.fromEntries((base.categories || []).map(cat => [cat.key, true])), profiled: true
009229:         });
009230:     }
009231: 
009232:     // Fiches statiques réellement complètes (V15).
009233:     for (const [displayName, attrs] of Object.entries(DLE_STATIC_PROFILES[key] || {})) {
009234:         if (!isCompleteDleAttrs(attrs, base.categories)) continue;
009235:         const canonical = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, displayName);
009236:         if (!canonical || byCanonical.has(canonical)) continue;
009237:         byCanonical.set(canonical, {
009238:             name: dleMasterDisplayName(key, canonical) || displayName,
009239:             attrs: { ...attrs },
009240:             attrKnown: Object.fromEntries((base.categories || []).map(cat => [cat.key, true])),
009241:             profiled: true
009242:         });
009243:     }
009244: 
009245:     for (const [cacheKey, attrs] of Object.entries(DLE_MANUAL_OVERRIDES || {})) {
009246:         const [u, raw] = cacheKey.split('|');
009247:         if (u !== key || !isCompleteDleAttrs(attrs, base.categories)) continue;
009248:         const canonical = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, raw);
009249:         if (!canonical || byCanonical.has(canonical)) continue;
009250:         byCanonical.set(canonical, {
009251:             name: dleMasterDisplayName(key, canonical), attrs: { ...attrs },
009252:             attrKnown: Object.fromEntries((base.categories || []).map(cat => [cat.key, true])), profiled: true
009253:         });
009254:     }
009255: 
009256:     for (const [raw, profile] of (DLE_VERIFIED_PROFILES[key] || new Map())) {
009257:         if (!isCompleteDleAttrs(profile.attrs, base.categories)) continue;
009258:         const canonical = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, profile.name || raw);
009259:         if (!canonical || byCanonical.has(canonical)) continue;
009260:         byCanonical.set(canonical, {
009261:             name: dleMasterDisplayName(key, canonical), attrs: { ...profile.attrs },
009262:             attrKnown: Object.fromEntries((base.categories || []).map(cat => [cat.key, true])), profiled: true
009263:         });
009264:     }
009265: 
009266:     // V19 : corrections vérifiées + retrait des doublons de forme (Goku Black = Zamasu, Estarossa = Mael...)
009267:     const excluded = new Set((DLE_EXCLUDE[key] || []).map(n => dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, n) || normalizeDle(n)));
009268:     const fixes = DLE_PROFILE_FIXES[key] || {};
009269:     const fixByCanon = new Map(Object.entries(fixes).map(([n, f]) => [dleMasterCanonicalNorm(key, n) || normalizeDle(n), f]));
009270:     const characters = [];
009271:     for (const [canon, c] of byCanonical) {
009272:         if (excluded.has(canon)) continue;
009273:         const f = fixByCanon.get(canon);
009274:         characters.push(f ? { ...c, attrs: { ...c.attrs, ...f } } : c);
009275:     }
009276: 
009277:     return { name: base.name, categories: [...(base.categories || [])], customCategoryCount:(base.categories||[]).length, characters };
009278: }

009306:         return u === universeKey && dleMasterCanonicalNorm(universeKey, n) === canonical && isCompleteDleAttrs(attrs, base.categories);

011437: function simpleImageNorm(value) {
011438:     return String(value || '')
011439:         .normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
011440:         .toLowerCase().replace(/[’']/g, '')
011441:         .replace(/&/g, ' and ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
011442:         .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
011443: }

011448: }
011449: function simpleMimeFromPath(p) {
011450:     const x = String(p || '').toLowerCase();
011451:     if (x.endsWith('.png')) return 'image/png';
011452:     if (x.endsWith('.gif')) return 'image/gif';
011453:     if (x.endsWith('.avif')) return 'image/avif';
011454:     if (x.endsWith('.webp')) return 'image/webp';
011455:     return 'image/jpeg';
011456: }

011460: function simpleImageIsPrivateHost(hostname) {
011461:     const h = String(hostname || '').toLowerCase();
011462:     if (!h || h === 'localhost' || h === '::1' || h.endsWith('.local')) return true;
011463:     if (/^127\./.test(h) || /^10\./.test(h) || /^192\.168\./.test(h) || /^169\.254\./.test(h)) return true;
011464:     const m = h.match(/^172\.(\d+)\./); if (m && Number(m[1]) >= 16 && Number(m[1]) <= 31) return true;
011465:     return false;
011466: }

011488: function simpleScoreName(candidate, wanted) {
011489:     const a = simpleImageNorm(candidate), b = simpleImageNorm(wanted);
011490:     if (!a || !b) return 0;
011491:     if (a === b) return 100;
011492:     if (simpleImageCompact(a) === simpleImageCompact(b)) return 98;
011493:     if (a.includes(b) || b.includes(a)) {
011494:         const sm = Math.min(a.length,b.length), lg = Math.max(a.length,b.length);
011495:         if (sm >= 4) return 83 + Math.round(14 * sm / lg);
011496:     }
011497:     const A = new Set(a.split(' ')), B = new Set(b.split(' ')); let common = 0;
011498:     for (const x of A) if (B.has(x)) common++;
011499:     return Math.round((common / Math.max(A.size,B.size,1)) * 82);
011500: }

014484: function arcBacCheck(cat, letter, input) {

008365:         function bbPick(side, ca, cb) {
008366:             if (!bb || bb.done || bb.busy) return;
008367:             bb.busy = true;
008368:             const a = bb.current[bb.idx], b = bb.current[bb.idx + 1];
008369:             const winner = side === 0 ? a : b, loser = side === 0 ? b : a;
008370:             (side === 0 ? ca : cb).classList.add('win');
008371:             (side === 0 ? cb : ca).classList.add('lose');
008372:             bb.history.push(JSON.stringify({ current: bb.current, next: bb.next, idx: bb.idx, duels: bb.duels, eliminated: bb.eliminated, bye: bb.bye, playin: bb.playin, qi: bb.qi, rounds: bb.rounds ? { ...bb.rounds, seen: [...bb.rounds.seen] } : null }));
008373:             bb.duels.push([winner, loser]);
008374:             bb.eliminated[loser] = bb.playin ? bb.size : bb.current.length;
008375:             bb.next.push(winner);
008376:             bb.idx += 2;
008377:             setTimeout(() => {
008378:                 bb.busy = false;
008379:                 if (bb.rounds) return qapRoundNext();

008382:                     bb.current = bb.bye ? bbShuffle([...bb.next, ...bb.bye]) : bb.next; bb.next = []; bb.idx = 0; bb.bye = null; bb.playin = false;
008383:                 }

008385:             }, 380);
008386:         }
